No allowable ripple current, self-heating or dv/dt / pulse-current rating is published in the catalogue; the 95 A edge current and the 1.81 A RMS bound (60 kHz) are not compared with any limit. Dissipation = I_rms^2 x ESR, and ESR at the edge spectrum (above self-resonance) is not published (Q >= 1000 is only at 1 MHz); 1.81 A and an ESR of 0.1 ohm (assumption) would be 0.33 W.

The 1.8 mm escape is below the 3.2 mm HOT rule by design; the 1.5 mm part gap is from the sibling-series catalogue, and the surface creepage at 490 V over 1.8 mm is unqualified (pad_escapes.json:3).
unchecked_layout: Physical functional-insulation qualification of the bounded escapes (up to 490 V across 1.8 mm on the surface)
